successCriteria.description: The ILeaveRequestService interface declares all 8 required methods: createDraft(CreateLeaveRequestDto): Promise<LeaveRequest>, submit(id: string): Promise<LeaveRequest>, approve(id: string, approverId: string): Promise<LeaveRequest>, reject(id: string, approverId: string): Promise<LeaveRequest>, cancel(id: string): Promise<LeaveRequest>, findById(id: string): Promise<LeaveRequest | null>, findByEmployeeId(employeeId: string): Promise<LeaveRequest[]>, query(params: LeaveRequestQueryParams): Promise<LeaveRequest[]>.

createDraft validates: employee exists (EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND), policy exists (POLICY_NOT_FOUND), policy isActive (POLICY_INACTIVE), startDate <= endDate (INVALID_DATE_RANGE), then creates a LeaveRequest with status DRAFT.

submit validates: request exists (REQUEST_NOT_FOUND), status is DRAFT (INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION), policy minimumNoticeDays is satisfied if set (MINIMUM_NOTICE_VIOLATION), balance exists (BALANCE_NOT_FOUND), balance is not CLOSED (BALANCE_CLOSED), remainingDays >= daysRequested using the BINDING formula (INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE), then transitions to SUBMITTED.

approve validates: request exists, status is SUBMITTED, approverId matches employee.managerId (NOT_MANAGER), balance exists and is not CLOSED, then deducts daysRequested from balance (usedDays += daysRequested, remainingDays = totalEntitlement - usedDays) and sets status APPROVED with approvedBy and approvedAt.
reject validates: request exists, status is SUBMITTED, approverId matches employee.managerId (NOT_MANAGER), then sets status REJECTED without touching balance.

cancel validates: request exists, status is SUBMITTED or APPROVED (INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION otherwise). If APPROVED, restores usedDays on balance (usedDays -= daysRequested, remainingDays = totalEntitlement - usedDays). Sets status CANCELLED with cancelledAt. If SUBMITTED, does not touch balance.

The BINDING day-counting formula `daysRequested = (endDate.getTime() - startDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24) + 1` is used at every call site that computes days (submit balance check, approve deduction, cancel restoration). A single-day leave (startDate === endDate) yields 1 day. A Mon-Fri range yields 5 days.

All state-changing operations reject invalid state transitions with error code INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION: DRAFT cannot be approved/rejected, SUBMITTED cannot be submitted, APPROVED/REJECTED/CANCELLED cannot be submitted/approved/rejected, DRAFT/REJECTED/CANCELLED cannot be cancelled.
Read-only methods (findById, findByEmployeeId, query) delegate directly to the corresponding ILeaveRequestRepository methods without additional business logic.

constraints: All errors thrown by the service must use the shape `{ error: string; code: string }` matching the reconciled architecture's error response contract.

The service constructor must accept exactly four dependencies: ILeaveRequestRepository, ILeaveBalanceRepository, ILeavePolicyRepository, IEmployeeRepository — all injected via constructor, no direct instantiation.
All imports from other modules must go through their barrel exports (index.ts) only — no deep imports from internal files (GP-001 / AGENTS.md rule 1).

The BINDING formula `(endDate.getTime() - startDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24) + 1` must be used identically at every call site — no variation, no weekend/holiday exclusion, no time-of-day consideration. All dates are full-day granularity.
Fiscal year is derived from `request.startDate.getFullYear()` — calendar year Jan 1 to Dec 31, hardcoded per the BINDING business rule.
The service must not directly access the database — all persistence goes through the injected repository interfaces (GP-001).
outOfScope: HTTP routes, controllers, request/response serialization, and Fastify plugin registration — these belong to Phase 9 (LeaveRequest routes and controller).
RBAC enforcement at the API boundary (requireRole guards, JWT verification) — the service is role-agnostic; authorization middleware is a Phase 9 concern.
Audit logging (GP-002) — the service does not write audit records. Audit integration is deferred to a later phase or cross-cutting concern.

entityInvariants.invariant: Lifecycle state machine: DRAFT → SUBMITTED → (APPROVED | REJECTED). CANCELLED is reachable from SUBMITTED or APPROVED. No other transitions are valid. The service must reject any attempt to transition outside this graph with INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION.

When status is APPROVED, approvedBy and approvedAt must both be non-null. When status is not APPROVED, both must be null. When status is CANCELLED, cancelledAt must be non-null. When status is not CANCELLED, cancelledAt must be null.

remainingDays = totalEntitlement - usedDays must hold after every mutation (approve deduction, cancel restoration). The service must compute both usedDays and remainingDays together and pass both to the repository update.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Caller must be authenticated (JWT). RBAC enforcement (employee role) is deferred to the controller/route layer — the service itself is role-agnostic.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Throws { error, code } on validation failure: EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND, POLICY_NOT_FOUND, POLICY_INACTIVE, INVALID_DATE_RANGE. Returns the created LeaveRequest on success.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Caller must be authenticated. RBAC enforcement deferred to controller.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Throws { error, code } on failure: REQUEST_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION, POLICY_NOT_FOUND, MINIMUM_NOTICE_VIOLATION, BALANCE_NOT_FOUND, BALANCE_CLOSED, INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE. Returns the updated LeaveRequest on success.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Caller must be authenticated. The service enforces that approverId === employee.managerId (NOT_MANAGER error). HR admin override is deferred to controller/route layer.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Throws { error, code } on failure: REQUEST_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION, EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND, NOT_MANAGER, BALANCE_NOT_FOUND, BALANCE_CLOSED. Returns the updated LeaveRequest on success.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Caller must be authenticated. The service enforces that approverId === employee.managerId (NOT_MANAGER error). HR admin override deferred to controller.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Throws { error, code } on failure: REQUEST_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION, EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND, NOT_MANAGER. Returns the updated LeaveRequest on success. Must not touch balance.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Caller must be authenticated. RBAC enforcement deferred to controller.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Throws { error, code } on failure: REQUEST_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION, BALANCE_NOT_FOUND, BALANCE_CLOSED. Returns the updated LeaveRequest on success. Restores balance only when cancelling an APPROVED request.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The service must use the LeaveStatus enum values (DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED) exactly as defined in the shared types module — no string literals for status values.
The service must use the LeaveRequest entity interface exactly as defined in the leave-request model — no additional or missing fields in create/update calls.
The service must use the CreateLeaveRequestDto and LeaveRequestQueryParams interfaces exactly as defined in shared types — no deviation in field names or types.

The service must use the ILeaveRequestRepository, ILeaveBalanceRepository, ILeavePolicyRepository, and IEmployeeRepository interfaces exactly as defined in their respective modules — no additional methods assumed beyond the declared interface.

integrationPoints.why: All CRUD operations on LeaveRequest entities — findById, findByEmployeeId, query, create, update — are delegated to this repository. The service never accesses the database directly.
Balance lookups (findByEmployeeAndPolicy) and mutations (update usedDays/remainingDays) during submit, approve, and cancel flows.
Policy lookups (findById) during createDraft (validate policy exists and isActive) and submit (validate minimumNoticeDays).
Employee lookups (findById) during createDraft (validate employee exists), approve (validate managerId match), and reject (validate managerId match).
